reconcile.note: Clarke reframes Jesus's avoidance of Judea as compliance with a providential timetable, his hour had not yet come, rather than fear-driven flight.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Daniel G. Taylor's BibViz Project, drawing on Skeptic's Annotated Bible data, presses that John 7:1 shows Jesus avoiding the very death-threat he told disciples not to fear.

sides.snippet: don't be afraid of those who kill the body
sides.verseText: \"I tell you, my friends, don't be afraid of those who kill the body, and after that have no more that they can do.

sides.snippet: he wouldn't walk in Judea, because the Jews sought to kill him
sides.verseText: After these things, Jesus was walking in Galilee, for he wouldn't walk in Judea, because the Jews sought to kill him.
